title: Name a grade with a function
objective: Write a function that returns text, choosing the answer with an if.

body.text: A function that returns text says returns text. Its if decides which words to give back. Because the function returns a value, you can use the call anywhere a text value is expected, such as in a say line.

body.title: Pass or fail
body.code:
function grade
    takes number called score
    returns text
    if score is at least 50
        gives back "Pass"
    gives back "Fail"

say grade 75
say grade 20

body.prompt: A score of 75 should pass, but the program prints Fail. Make it print Pass.
body.starter:
